Definition: Integration of driver's license registration and traffic offence data
Comments: No specific evidence found regarding driver licensing integration with Cape Verde's data exchange infrastructure. The NOSi e-gov solutions list does not include a driver licensing system.
redteam_note: No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Original cited source (NOSi e-gov solutions list) does not mention driver licensing and does not support a score of 0/Unknown as strongly as claimed — it simply omits the topic rather than confirming non-integration. A targeted search found a primary source that changes the picture: a 16 December 2025 press release from Cabo Verde's Ministério da Justiça (IMIJ) states that approximately 62 public and private institutions — explicitly including DGTR (Direção Geral dos Transportes Rodoviários, the road transport/driver-licensing authority) — are integrated with the RNI (national identification registry) and SNIAC data-exchange subsystems for secure data consumption via institutional protocols. This is a specific, authoritative, dated confirmation that the driver-licensing authority is connected to the national data exchange, which the original score of 'Unknown' misses. It is not clear from this source whether DGTR's own licensing/traffic-offence data is fed back out to other consumers (full bidirectional integration), only that DGTR consumes/exchanges data via RNI/SNIAC, so I have scored this as Partially integrated (4) rather than Fully integrated (5). Separately, Boletim Oficial No. 77/2025 (19 August 2025) shows Cape Verde has adopted a legal framework establishing a computerised registration system for driver and non-driver traffic offences and a points system for serious offences, indicating parallel digitisation of the traffic-offence side of this variable. Given this rests on a single (though authoritative) government press release without independent corroboration of the exact integration mechanics, flagging for human review to confirm the partial-vs-full distinction.
revised_comments: Cabo Verde's road transport authority (DGTR) is integrated with the national data exchange. A December 2025 statement from the Ministry of Justice's IMIJ confirms that DGTR is among roughly 62 public and private institutions connected to the RNI (national identification registry) and SNIAC systems, consuming shared data via institutional protocols under the oversight of the national data protection authority (CNPD). Separately, a legal instrument published in August 2025 (Boletim Oficial No. 77/2025) establishes a computerised national register for driver and non-driver traffic offences and an associated points system for serious road-traffic infractions, indicating that the traffic-offence side of licensing is also being digitised. Together these point to partial integration of driver licensing and traffic-offence functions into the country's data exchange architecture, short of full, comprehensive integration.
